title: Support-Staff Impersonation without Auditing or Access Control
pattern: Exposing diagnostic or debugging endpoints that allow administrators or support staff to impersonate standard users without checking for strict validation tokens, authentication context, or auditing.
why_bad: Provides a massive backdoor vector. If an attacker compromises a support workstation or has administrative privileges, they can read or manipulate customer records without detection, breaching user privacy.
detection: Methods providing administrative impersonation (`impersonate`, `get_view_as`) lacking multi-party authorization or deep logging wrappers.
fix: Require support staff to use safe proxies with multi-party authorization (MPA), structured ticketing system justifications, and tamper-resistant audit logs of the action.
source: `Heather Adkins et al. - Building Secure and Reliable Systems (2020)`, Ch 15, p. 359.
